action_args.justification: The series is trend-dominated with weak seasonality and high predictability. Model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.041) and several models carry correlated error, so no subset or fitted weighting can reliably outperform a simple average. The full-pool mean already captures the diversity benefit: it outperforms all pool-restricted variants (pool1/2/3), the median, and the weighted meta-model. With only 3 validation windows, weight estimation is high-variance, and the 'indistinguishable' verdict confirms no strategy is statistically better. The plain mean is the robust, low-variance choice for this trend-dominated series.
